verdict.rationale: Public pages offer an online service to check visa processing times that "will tell you when you can expect a decision" (docs-20, supp-3). The eVisa service lets you view your granted immigration status online (docs-2). Neither is shown to be a live tracker for a pending application or case: the processing-time tool gives an expected decision date, and eVisa covers status after a grant. Missing for 10: per-application live status lookup for pending filings, documentation of status stages or notifications for a submitted case, independent or hands-on corroboration.
